name: What Remains of Us
source:
When you left the capital to escape the clutches of the sun god's council, you hoped that you could put your past behind you and start anew.  Unfortunately for you, pasts always have a way of catching up to people; and yours just happened to come in the package of a bleeding man at your doorway.

[from [url=https://siyokoy.itch.io/what-remains]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你离开都城逃离太阳神议会的魔爪时，你希望能够抛开过去，重新开始。对你来说不幸的是，过去总是有办法追上人们；而你的包裹恰好是放在门口一个流血的人的包裹里的。

[来自[url=https://siyokoy.itch.io/what-remains]itch.io[/url]]
